what: Round-12 audit: where the 'missing ~12 ms' of the per-pixel half actually is. Instruments: probes/a12_ballast.js, a12_scene2.js, a12_cpu.js (a12_gpu.js and the resize-based probes are kept as documentation of instrument failures).

instrumentFailuresFound.timerQueries: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 on ANGLE Metal bills each query a command-buffer boundary: 317.7 ms of 'GPU' in a 24 ms frame, a 64x64 blit billed 15 ms. Unusable; do not build on r8_gpu.js.
instrumentFailuresFound.dvfs: The M3 Pro downclocks under light GPU load. An identical scene-only config read 4.7 ms right after a heavy block and 16.1 ms right after a light one; 6 extra fullscreen blits cost 0. Any wall-clock measurement of a LIGHT configuration measures the power governor, not the work. Fix: constant fullscreen-blit ballast in every config so clocks cancel in differences; ballast priced in-run (0.26-0.47 ms/blit depending on session).
instrumentFailuresFound.uninitializedTargets: setRenderScale reallocates targets; a skipped pass then leaves NaN-dense uninitialized half-float memory that in-scene samplers (volumetric composite quad) read with blending, wrecking the raster. Scene-only at 0.55 scale read SLOWER than at 1.0 until targets were explicitly cleared.

sessionFrameMsNative: 22.9-26.4 across sessions (moving camera, 1920x1080); r11_fill's 26.44 is in-band

cpu.reading: frame is GPU-bound; submit blocks on back-pressure; CPU is irrelevant

decompositionMsAtNative.sceneIntoHdrTotal: 12.4-15.2 (two sessions; ~14 typical) — NOT the 6.8-8.8 in TODO.md
decompositionMsAtNative.bloomAll: 0.8-1.7 (r11's 'below noise' wrong at least at the top of this band)
decompositionMsAtNative.closure: base + sum of marginals predicted 33.99 vs measured 32.14 (session 1), 31.48 vs 31.63 (session 2), with 0.16-0.5 ms null controls

verdictOnTodoSection1: The '~12 ms is in the unflagged passes (prep, luminance, adaptation, composite, present)' belief is FALSE: those five together cost ~1.5-2 ms. The unattributed time is the scene render itself (~14 ms, double the number r11 booked) plus under-measured DOF (~3 not 0.89) and bloom (~1 not 0).
